name: Social stickers
description: Sticker and custom emoji packs: the list of packs the user added (stickers/packs.json in the app's data folder). The free packs of the catalog are fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com (the catalog/ folder of the Social repo) when the user opens it. The picture files themselves are engine assets; this file only names them, which also keeps them safe from the Storage cleanup and carries them through sync and backup.
